_note: Rarities shared by everything that can carry one (Yusuf, 2026-10-22): blueprints first, then items, relics and dawn cards. An entity says "rarity": "<id>" in its own data; no rarity means white. order = rarest last. name = what players read; color = the card or label colour (hex); weight = how much less often a rarer one is offered than a white one where offers are drawn at random (1.0 = as often).
